lastCompletedStory.title: Review round 1 fix 002: address reviewer finding

nextStoryContext: ADR-0050's 'deckward' runner-up bullet (AC5, line 64) was corrected per the reviewer's US-R1-002 finding: the elimination reason was mis-attributed to 'Deckard, the Blade Runner protagonist' (a 1982 film character, a weak pop-culture collision), when the operator's actual recorded reason in CAM-434 spec.gotchas is 'Deckard, codinome do Steam Frame da Valve, com ciclo de noticias quente em 2026' (Valve's Steam Frame headset codename, an actively-launching hardware product with a hot 2026 news cycle). The bullet now attributes the collision to the Valve Steam Frame codename, the same live-homonym class as ADR-0050's layer-4 gate. This was the last of the two US-R1 reviewer findings (US-R1-001 handled the other nine bullets + prowmark); no other part of ADR-0050 was touched. No code, template, or binary was touched (docs-only ADR correction).
